mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 3% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 5% for three consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1.0%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST for two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating economic demand, which compresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.8%) in at least 50% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for three consecutive months signals accelerating supply activity, which typically precedes margin compression and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month MA +2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% coincident with a rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% for two months signals a policy-lag environment, where monetary loosening fails to curb inflation, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipation of future rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month MA +1% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.7%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 6-month moving averages for one month signals strengthening aggregate demand, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 6-month MA AND RSAFS > 6-month MA for one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1.2%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO remains below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months, indicating persistent supply weakness, which depresses earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.8%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.
